prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE SQUARE transparent Minecraft mineral overlay authored as coarse LOGICAL 16x16 pixel art.
Primary request: Copper Bloom QUIET variant, a short natural gray-olive sulfide exposure on one fracture tip. Draw ONE solid connected stepped formation of eight to ten large square logical cells, each about 1/16 canvas width: a 2-cell-thick, 4-cell-long irregular bend, with one slightly offset terminal cell. This is a partial mineralized fracture, not a centered nugget or complete vein network.
Scene/backdrop: genuine alpha-zero transparency on almost the entire square; only the mineral formation has color. No rendered host rock, matte, checkerboard, shadow or glow.
Style/medium: Minecraft Java 16x16 hard square pixel clusters at high resolution, crisp flat cells, no subpixel scratches, no hairlines, no antialiasing.
Composition/framing: The grouped sulfide cells are opaque and MUST remain a connected 6–10-cell physical shape when sampled at exact centers of a 16x16 grid. Put it off-center, with no edge contact required and broad clear space all around. The formation covers only about 3–5% of the block. Do not make the cells smaller to signify subtlety; quietness comes from limited area and close medium colors.
Materials/textures: two close muted gray-olive sulfide values around #797c69 and #8a876e within the connected formation; at most one subdued oxidation cell attached to it. No saturated yellow or green, no high-contrast border, no white quartz.
Constraints: exactly one 1:1 PNG at least 1024x1024, hard-edged mostly opaque mineral pixels, true transparent alpha outside, no cropping/rescaling, no stone/deepslate, text, watermark or panel.
Avoid: 1–3 pixel speck, thin diagonal scratch, disconnected confetti, bright brass, turquoise, green dots, full stockwork, X, outline rails, glow, gradient, smooth painting.
disposition: Retained unchanged as first pattern within category; active human review
